text:
maya: heads up — cutoff for v1.8.0 in ~2 hours. planning to create an annotated tag + GH draft. need owners for artifacts and checksum publish :hourglass_flowing_sand:

nate: I can own the tag + pushing the release draft. which commit sha are we tagging?

maya: tag main@c9f2a4b — PR 412 merged, CI green. bump PR already landed.

eli: I'll upload linux/mac wheels and docker images to s3 (s3://redwood-releases/v1.8.0/) — ETA ~45m.

kevin: quick changelog blurb incoming. can someone confirm if we include the quantization note?

maya: yes include small note: "batching, kernel selector fixes, quantization stability tweak" — keep it short.

nate: plan: wait for artifacts + checksums, then I will create annotated tag and push. tag/push commands I use:

```

git tag -a v1.8.0 c9f2a4b -m "v1.8.0 — batching & runtime fixes"

git push origin v1.8.0

```

nate: also will create the GH draft titled "v1.8.0 — batching & runtime fixes" and attach artifact links + checksums.

eli: after uploads I'll run checksum and copy to s3:

```

sha256sum build/* > checksums-v1.8.0.txt

aws s3 cp checksums-v1.8.0.txt s3://redwood-releases/v1.8.0/

```

release-bot: draft release created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/releases/tag/v1.8.0 (draft) — placeholder until assets attached.

sre-oncall: quick note: tagging window after 20:00 UTC ok for rollback window. if anything blocks we should hold.

kevin: changelog snippet: "Improve batching heuristics; fix stride bug in kernel selector; small quantization stability patch."

maya: perfect. nate — can you sign the annotated tag (GPG) vs lightweight? we prefer annotated+signature.

nate: yes will sign (-s) and push signed tag after checksums are up. also will leave a line in draft: artifacts uploaded by eli, checksums verified.

eli: uploads done — s3 links: s3://redwood-releases/v1.8.0/linux.tar.gz, s3://redwood-releases/v1.8.0/mac.tar.gz, docker images pushed to ghcr. checksums uploaded too.

nate: saw checksums, doing final smoke on staging and will tag in ~10m.

kevin: QA smoke looked good earlier, just flagged one log spam. not blocking.

maya: if all green, go ahead with signed tag and push + publish GH draft as final. @channel thanks everyone. :tada:
